questions.solution_html:
• A dataset has many features, but only some of them are useful. Explain how feature
  • selection can help.
  • Feature selection is the process of selecting the most relevant and useful features from a dataset
  • while removing irrelevant or redundant features. It helps improve the performance of a Machine
  • Learning model. (1 mark)
  • How feature selection helps - 1. Improves model accuracy: Removing irrelevant features can help the
  • model make better predictions. 2. Reduces overfitting: It reduces the chance of the model learning
  • unnecessary patterns from the training data. 3. Reduces computational time: Fewer features require
  • less processing time and memory. 4. Simplifies the model: A model with fewer features is easier to
  • understand and interpret. 5. Removes irrelevant data: It eliminates features that do not contribute
  • significantly to the prediction. (2 marks)
